review.reviewer: Codex delivery owner; author self-review, not independent approval
review.decision: APPROVE R4/R5 observable boundary design before test edits
review.notes: Use actual resumeAgents output path and actual runRemoteRestore/restorejob.Store persistence, plus rendered RN client and response parsing. Every native/compatibility sender must use log-only tmux.Bin; temporary HOME/CODEX_HOME/socket are explicit in fixture and runner. Preserve the prior real %7 incident, approval rejection, CI failures, expenses and stage2 timing excess. No actual Codex/device/CI is implied. Independent full candidate review and complete gates remain separate.

cases.description: Local terminal outcome is visible before the next preparation
cases.setup: Two recoverable saved panes, private HOME/socket, fixed native classifier, actual SendText to log-only tmux stub; stdout is a private file
cases.action: Call actual resumeAgents; inspect captured stdout at B preparation after A exhausts startup wait; compare remote mode suppression
cases.expected: Local pane A and explicit startup timeout appear before B preparation; no confirmation is fabricated; command and Enter log is exact and no real tmux is reachable

cases.description: Remote final store preserves the first issue fact separately from timeout
cases.setup: Actual restorejob.Store reserve/claim/update/get and runRemoteRestore; same isolated two-pane production resumeAgents fixture, sender returns pending versus unknown
cases.action: Read intermediate and completed job snapshots and a fresh store Get after the worker finishes
cases.expected: Both final results retain startup-timeout; first pending versus unknown remains distinguishable as issue_state after persistence, without replay or extra sender calls

cases.description: Rendered remote client shows uncertainty and timeout in both languages
cases.setup: Actual RestoreSessionsSheet renderer with final persisted-shape result fixtures; injected read-only client and isolated Keychain mock
cases.action: Render pending/unknown/send-failed startup-timeout results in English and Chinese; parse valid optional issue_state and malformed values
cases.expected: User sees startup timeout and original unknown/send-failed distinctly; old responses without issue_state remain accepted; malformed optional values are rejected; no POST/send occurs
